name: Steakhouse High Yield USDC Edition
oneLiner: sirloinUSDC is Steakhouse's broader-collateral USDC lending vault on Base; interest accrues to shares, losses reduce NAV, and withdrawals depend on liquidity.
collateral: USDC held idle or supplied through a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2. The pinned book is concentrated in USDe-backed lending, with mGLO, cbXRP, cbBTC, cbZEC, cbETH, cbHYPE and JitoSOL collateral securing the other loans; these are borrower collateral, not assets held directly by the vault.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a proportional USDC-denominated lending position. Interest and fee-share accrual change assets per share; bad debt reduces NAV. Ordinary withdrawals burn shares for idle USDC plus liquidity available through the selected adapter. Force-deallocation is a separate exit with a configurable penalty; maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero and do not measure available liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0.001% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The operational ERC-4626 claim is the exact Base VaultV2, not direct ownership of Circle reserves. Source-matched immutable core at Base block 52630636 (2026-10-15T07:50:19Z) pulls USDC before user minting, mints configured fee shares on accrual and burns shares for available underlying on exit. Creation transaction 0x365e979eb98424e0fcedad75285d1c9ae4cd4be4a3a3841318666316f4082bf7 emits this vault's Constructor event at block 45427904, 2026-05-01T14:19:15Z; this dates the implementation rather than the operator or parent token.
